name: AI Maze Escape — Gauntlet Loop
goal: Autonomous cinematic 3D maze escape with AAA reference-quality environments, characters and gameplay.
qualityBar: The Talos Principle 2 (environment and composition); Little Nightmares III (characters and cinematic atmosphere); Labyrinthine (maze systems).
referencePolicy: Use licensed/public official gameplay captures for visual A/B. Never declare victory without inspected screenshots and real runtime evidence.

rounds.label: Existing game audit and first playable 3D scene
built: Procedural 3D stone floors, walls, rooms, keys, locked doors and exit
rounds.independentCritic: Pending: external pixel-level blind A/B, real browser screenshots and endurance evidence
rounds.largestKnownGap: Procedural 3D characters and environments are not yet comparable to authored AAA assets, lighting, animation and art direction.
rounds.baseline: R4 software candidate; 88/100 production evidence score according to existing repository documents.

rounds.label: Movement, failure fallback and live threat
built: Interpolate explorer movement without resetting position every tick
Throttle 3D environment rebuilds to reduce CPU churn
Check WebGL2 support and return to the 2D view after a lost GPU context
Activate a deterministic hunter for the livestream preset
Capture 3D Chromium screenshot in browser test
rounds.independentCritic: No independent visual critic has inspected the running game: coding-agent connection unavailable and GitHub CI queued.
rounds.largestKnownGap: Author-quality character rig, detailed maze materials and atmospheric lighting remain far short of AAA references; measured gameplay FPS and real A/B captures are outstanding.

milestones.label: Preserve deterministic AI and hidden-information fairness
Upgrade character models and cinematic animations
Art-directed scenes, materials, lighting and audio
Independent visual A/B and functional acceptance
